decision.explanation: The source documents provide two distinct positions held by Friedrich von Amerling. Document 1 (D1) explicitly states he was 'court painter' to the Austrian imperial family (D1S2, D1S5). Document 2 (D2) claims he was a 'member of the European Parliament' starting in 1875 (D2S2, D2S3). Although Document 2 presents a historically implausible claim (the European Parliament did not exist in 1875), the instruction requires treating all provided source segments as fallible data and preserving distinct valid referents/answers found in the text without inventing external constraints to reject them. Therefore, both positions mentioned in the text are included as the answer.
